headline: Singapore Airlines Announces S$2 Billion Cabin Upgrade for Luxury Travel
summary: Singapore Airlines announced a S$2 billion cabin upgrade featuring the largest double bed in the sky to capture demand from wealthy first-class passengers.
why: Airlines invest heavily in premium cabin enhancements to capture higher-margin revenue from business and luxury travelers, supporting profitability during periods of fluctuating travel demand.

impacts.name: Singapore Airlines
impacts.why: A multi-billion dollar capital expenditure program directly affects the airline's financial investments.
